current <- read_csv(
  here(
    "Data_pedestrians",
    "raw2",
    "pedestrian_counts_raw.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  clean_names()

current_clean <- current |>
  transmute(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count = pedestriancount,
    source = "Current API"
  )
# Historical data
historical <- read_csv(
  here(
    "Data_pedestrians",
    "raw",
    "Pedestrian_Counting_System_Monthly_counts_per_hour_may_2009_to_14_dec_2022.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  clean_names()

# Historical data standarise
historical_clean <- historical |>
  mutate(
    sensing_date = mdy(
      str_c(month, mdate, year, sep = " ")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    sensor_id,
    sensing_date
  ) |>
  arrange(
    id,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hour_repaired =
      n() == 24 & n_distinct(time) == 1,

    hourday = if_else(
      hour_repaired,
      row_number() - 1,
      time
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    location_id = sensor_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count = hourly_counts,
    hour_repaired,
    source = "Historical"
  )
# Combine
pedestrian_full <- bind_rows(
  historical_clean,
  current_clean
) |>
  arrange(
    sensing_date,
    location_id,
    hourday
  )
pedestrian_full <- pedestrian_full |>
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(sensing_date),
    month = lubridate::month(sensing_date),

    month_name = lubridate::month(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE
    ),

    day_name = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE,
      week_start = 1
    ),

    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      week_start = 1
    ),

    is_weekend = day_of_week >= 6,

    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    )
  )
# Check for missing values
pedestrian_full |>
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    locations = n_distinct(location_id),
    first_date = min(sensing_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_date = max(sensing_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_dates = sum(is.na(sensing_date)),
    missing_hours = sum(is.na(hourday)),
    missing_counts = sum(is.na(pedestrian_count))
  )

  • A small number of historical sensor-day groups contained 24 distinct hourly count observations but duplicated timestamps; where the record ordering clearly preserved the hourly sequence, hour labels were reconstructed from record order, with repaired observations flagged.

  • Recieved this data on 29/09/2026 from data operations manager at city of melbourne on personal mail.

# Check daily coverage
snapshot_daily_coverage <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    x <- data.table::fread(
      file = f,
      select = c("Sensing_Date")
    )
    
    dates <- as.Date(x$Sensing_Date)
    
    data.frame(
      file = basename(f),
      days_observed = data.table::uniqueN(dates),
      expected_days = ifelse(
        lubridate::leap_year(min(dates)),
        366,
        365
      ),
      missing_days = ifelse(
        lubridate::leap_year(min(dates)),
        366,
        365
      ) - data.table::uniqueN(dates)
    )
  }
)

# Check for duplicates
snapshot_duplicates <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    x <- data.table::fread(
      file = f,
      select = c(
        "Location_ID",
        "Sensing_Date",
        "HourDay"
      )
    )
    
    dup <- x[
      ,
      .N,
      by = .(Location_ID, Sensing_Date, HourDay)
    ][N > 1]
    
    data.frame(
      file = basename(f),
      duplicate_groups = nrow(dup),
      duplicated_rows = sum(dup$N - 1)
    )
  }
)

# Validate snapshot data
snapshot_2022 <- data.table::fread(
  file.path(snapshot_dir, "2022_Pedestrian_Data.csv"),
  select = c(
    "Location_ID",
    "Sensing_Date",
    "HourDay",

historical_2022 <- pedestrian_full %>%
  filter(year == 2022) %>%
  select(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count
  )

# Comparing the snapshot data with the above pedestrian_full data
comparison_2022 <- snapshot_2022 %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Sensing_Date = as.Date(Sensing_Date)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    historical_2022,
    by = c(
      "Location_ID" = "location_id",
      "Sensing_Date" = "sensing_date",
      "HourDay" = "hourday"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    count_difference = PedestrianCount - pedestrian_count
  )

    Sensing_Date = as.Date(Sensing_Date)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    pedestrian_full %>%
      filter(lubridate::year(sensing_date) == 2025) %>%
      select(
        location_id,
        sensing_date,
        hourday,
        pedestrian_count
      ),
    by = c(
      "Location_ID" = "location_id",
      "Sensing_Date" = "sensing_date",
      "HourDay" = "hourday"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = PedestrianCount - pedestrian_count
  )


comparison_2025 %>%
  summarise(
    matched_rows = n(),
    different_rows = sum(difference != 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_difference = mean(difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_absolute_difference = max(abs(difference), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

Standardisation and Integration

Standardise Snapshot Data

snapshot_standardised <- purrr::map_dfr(
  snapshot_files,
  function(f) {
    
    
    x <- data.table::fread(file = f) %>%
      as_tibble()
    
    x %>%
      transmute(
        location_id = as.numeric(Location_ID),
        sensing_date = as.Date(Sensing_Date),
        hourday = as.numeric(HourDay),
        pedestrian_count = as.numeric(PedestrianCount),
        hour_repaired = FALSE,
        source = paste0("city_snapshot_", substr(basename(f), 1, 4))
      )
  }
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(sensing_date),
    month = lubridate::month(sensing_date),
    month_name = lubridate::month(sensing_date, label = TRUE),
    day_name = lubridate::wday(sensing_date, label = TRUE),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(sensing_date, week_start = 1),
    is_weekend = day_of_week >= 6,
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    )
  )

Replace 2022–2025 with Validated Snapshots

## Rebuild final pedestrian dataset

### Keep historical data before 2022

historical_data <- pedestrian_full %>%
  filter(!year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) %>%
  select(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count,
    source,
    any_of("hour_repaired")
  )

# If the historical dataset does not contain hour_repaired,
# create it as FALSE.
if (!"hour_repaired" %in% names(historical_data)) {
  historical_data$hour_repaired <- FALSE
}


### Prepare validated 2022–2025 snapshots

snapshot_data <- snapshot_standardised %>%
  select(
    location_id,
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    pedestrian_count,
    source
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hour_repaired = FALSE
  )


### Combine historical and validated data

pedestrian_full_updated <- bind_rows(
  historical_data,
  snapshot_data
) %>%
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(sensing_date),

    month = lubridate::month(sensing_date),

    month_name = lubridate::month(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE
    ),

    day_name = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE
    ),

    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(
      sensing_date,
      week_start = 1
    ),

    is_weekend = day_of_week >= 6,

    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    sensing_date,
    hourday,
    location_id
)

Daily and Weekly Pedestrian Rhythm

Hourly Pedestrian Activity Over Time

hourly_by_sensor_year <- pedestrian_full %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(hourday),
    hourday >= 0,
    hourday <= 23
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, location_id, hourday) %>%
  summarise(
    sensor_hour_avg = mean(pedestrian_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hourly_by_year <- hourly_by_sensor_year %>%
  group_by(year, hourday) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_pedestrians = mean(sensor_hour_avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hourly_index <- hourly_by_year %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    yearly_mean = mean(avg_pedestrians, na.rm = TRUE),
    activity_index = avg_pedestrians / yearly_mean * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

hourly_summary <- hourly_index %>%
  group_by(hourday) %>%
  summarise(
    median_index = median(activity_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(activity_index, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(activity_index, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
daily_interactive_data <- hourly_index %>%
  mutate(
    year_label = case_when(
      year == 2009 ~ "2009 (partial)",
      year == 2026 ~ "2026 (partial)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(year)
    )
  )

PLOT 1 — Typical Daily Pedestrian Rhythm

daily_interactive <- plot_ly(
  daily_interactive_data,
  x = ~hourday,
  y = ~activity_index,
  color = ~year_label,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines",
  text = ~paste0(
    "Year: ", year_label,
    "<br>Hour: ", hourday, ":00",
    "<br>Activity index: ", round(activity_index, 1)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Daily Pedestrian Rhythm by Year",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Hour of day",
      tickmode = "linear",
      tick0 = 0,
      dtick = 1
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Activity index (100 = yearly average)"
    ),
    hovermode = "closest",
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Year"),
      orientation = "v",
      x = 1.02,
      y = 1
    ),
    margin = list(r = 150)
  )

  filter(

  ) |>
  group_by(
    location_id,

  ) |>
  summarise(

      pedestrian_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    hours_observed = n_distinct(hourday),
    
    .groups = "drop"

    hours_observed >= 20

  day_of_week = lubridate::wday(
    sensing_date,

sensor_event_index <- sensor_daily_events |>
  arrange(
    location_id,
    day_of_week,
    sensing_date
  ) |>
  group_by(
    location_id,
    day_of_week
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expected_count = slide_dbl(
      daily_count,
      ~ median(
        .x[-5],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .before = 4,
      .after = 4,
      .complete = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    uplift_percent =
      100 *
      (daily_count - expected_count) /
      expected_count
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(uplift_percent)
  )
event_day_summary <- sensor_event_index |>
  group_by(sensing_date) |>
  summarise(
    median_uplift = median(
      uplift_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    sensors_reporting = n_distinct(location_id),
    
    sensors_above_20 = sum(
      uplift_percent >= 20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    proportion_above_20 = mean(
      uplift_percent >= 20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    median_daily_count = median(
      daily_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  arrange(sensing_date) |>

    ],
    
    peak_uplift = max(
      median_uplift,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    max_proportion_above_20 = max(
      proportion_above_20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(peak_uplift))

Summarise pedestrian decreases across sensors

decrease_day_summary <- sensor_event_index %>%
  group_by(
    sensing_date
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    median_decrease = median(
      uplift_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sensors_reporting = n_distinct(
      location_id
    ),

    sensors_below_20 = sum(
      uplift_percent <= -20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    proportion_below_20 = mean(
      uplift_percent <= -20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_daily_count = median(
      daily_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

Identify significant pedestrian decreases

  filter(
    sensors_reporting >= 10,
    median_decrease <= -20,
    proportion_below_20 >= 0.30

  arrange(
    median_decrease
  )

# Cleaning the inconsistency in the events dataset
event_permits_relevant <- event_permits |>
  mutate(
    category_1_clean = category_1 |>
      str_to_lower() |>
      str_squish() |>
      str_replace_all(
        "non\\s*-?\\s*ticketed",
        "non-ticketed"
      ) |>
      str_replace_all(
        "run\\s*/?\\s*walk",
        "run/walk"
      ),

    event_type = case_when(

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "non-ticketed"
        ) ~
        "Non-ticketed public event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "ticketed"
        ) ~
        "Ticketed public event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "run/walk"
        ) ~
        "Run/Walk",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "music"
        ) ~
        "Music event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "cycling"
        ) ~
        "Cycling event",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "parade"
        ) ~
        "Parade",

      str_detect(
        category_1_clean,
        "^public event"
      ) &
        str_detect(
          category_1_clean,
          "memorial"
        ) ~
        "Memorial",

      category_1_clean == "public event" ~
        "Other public event",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(event_type)
  )
event_permits_qc <- event_permits_relevant |>
  mutate(
    duration_days =
      as.numeric(event_end - event_start) + 1,

    permit_match_class = case_when(
      is.na(event_end) ~
        "Missing end date",

      duration_days <= 7 ~
        "Suitable for automatic matching",

      duration_days <= 30 ~
        "Extended permit - inspect manually",

      duration_days > 30 ~
        "Long permit window - do not auto-match"
    )
  )

event_permits_qc |>
  count(
    permit_match_class,
    sort = TRUE
  )

event_permits_auto <- event_permits_qc |>
  filter(
    permit_match_class ==
      "Suitable for automatic matching"
  )

event_permits_extended <- event_permits_qc |>
  filter(
    permit_match_class !=

  )
event_episodes_2014_2018 <-
  event_episode_candidates |>
  filter(
    end_date >= ymd("2014-01-01"),
    start_date <= ymd("2018-12-31")
  )


event_episode_matches <-
  event_episodes_2014_2018 |>
  inner_join(
    event_permits_auto,
    by = join_by(
      start_date <= event_end,
      end_date >= event_start
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    peak_date_inside_event =
      peak_date >= event_start &
      peak_date <= event_end
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(peak_uplift),
    desc(peak_date_inside_event)
  )
event_episode_matches_checked <- event_episode_matches |>
  mutate(
    date_match_quality = case_when(
      duration_days == 1 &
        peak_date == event_start ~
        "Exact one-day permit match",

      duration_days > 1 &
        peak_date_inside_event ~
        "Within short permit window",

      TRUE ~
        "Weak date match"
    )
  )


event_matches_temporally_plausible <- event_episode_matches_checked |>
  filter(peak_date_inside_event)

        date_label,
        peak_uplift
      ),
      text = hover_text
    )
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = peak_uplift,
      yend = forcats::fct_reorder(
        date_label,
        peak_uplift
      )
    ),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = max_proportion_above_20
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    range = c(3, 7)

  labs(

    x = "Median pedestrian uplift (%)",

Weather and Pedestrian Activity Analysis

weather_daily <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("Data_pedestrians", "raw2", "melbourne_weather_daily.csv"),
  skip = 3,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    sensing_date = as.Date(time),

    max_temperature_c = `temperature_2m_max (°C)`,

    min_temperature_c = `temperature_2m_min (°C)`,

    max_wind_kmh = `wind_speed_10m_max (km/h)`,

    rainfall_mm = `precipitation_sum (mm)`
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sensing_date >= as.Date("2009-05-01"),
    sensing_date <= as.Date("2026-09-06")
  )

weather_daily %>%
  summarise(
    total_days = n(),
    first_date = min(sensing_date),
    last_date = max(sensing_date),
    missing_rainfall = sum(is.na(rainfall_mm)),
    duplicate_dates = n() - n_distinct(sensing_date)
  )

Combine Weather with Pedestrian Decreases

weather_dip_daily <- decrease_day_summary %>%
  filter(
    sensors_reporting >= 10,
    lubridate::year(sensing_date) %in%
      c(2019, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    weather_daily,
    by = "sensing_date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    significant_dip =
      median_decrease <= -20 &
      proportion_below_20 >= 0.30,

    public_holiday =
      sensing_date %in%
      holiday_calendar_official$holiday_date
  )

weather_dip_daily %>%
  summarise(
    total_days = n(),
    significant_dip_days = sum(significant_dip),
    public_holiday_days = sum(public_holiday),
    holiday_dip_days = sum(significant_dip & public_holiday),
    missing_weather = sum(is.na(rainfall_mm)),
    duplicate_dates = n() - n_distinct(sensing_date)
  )

    median_max_wind_kmh =

rainfall_levels <- weather_dip_daily %>%
  filter(!public_holiday) %>%
  mutate(
    rainfall_group = case_when(
      rainfall_mm == 0 ~ "No rain",
      rainfall_mm < 2 ~ "0–2 mm",
      rainfall_mm < 5 ~ "2–5 mm",
      rainfall_mm < 10 ~ "5–10 mm",
      rainfall_mm < 20 ~ "10–20 mm",
      TRUE ~ "20 mm or more"
    ),

    rainfall_group = factor(
      rainfall_group,
      levels = c(

        "5–10 mm",

  group_by(rainfall_group) %>%
  summarise(
    total_days = n(),
    significant_dip_days = sum(significant_dip),

    dip_percentage = round(
      mean(significant_dip) * 100,
      1
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine weather, pedestrian changes and holiday names

weather_holiday_yearly <- weather_dip_daily %>%
  left_join(
    holiday_calendar_official %>%
      group_by(holiday_date) %>%
      summarise(
        holiday = paste(unique(holiday), collapse = " / "),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("sensing_date" = "holiday_date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_label = factor(
      as.character(lubridate::year(sensing_date)),
      levels = c("2019", "2023", "2024", "2025", "2026")
    ),

    # Align all years by month and day for comparison
    plot_date = as.Date(
      paste0("2024-", format(sensing_date, "%m-%d"))
    ),

    holiday_name = coalesce(
      holiday,
      "Not a public holiday"
    ),

    hover_text = paste0(
      "Date: ", format(sensing_date, "%d %B %Y"),
      "<br>Holiday: ", holiday_name,
      "<br>Median pedestrian change: ",

      "<br>Minimum temperature: ", min_temperature_c, "°C",
      "<br>Maximum wind speed: ", max_wind_kmh, " km/h",
      "<br>Sensors reporting: ", sensors_reporting
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(year_label, plot_date)
### Smoothed Pedestrian Changes, Weather and Holidays by Year

smoothed_yearly_data <- weather_holiday_yearly %>%
  group_by(year_label) %>%
  arrange(sensing_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    smoothed_change = slider::slide_dbl(
      median_decrease,
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before = 3,
      .after = 3
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Coloured line for each year

)

recent_data <- pedestrian_full |>
  filter(
    year %in% 2023:2025,
    between(hourday, 0, 23),
    !is.na(pedestrian_count),
    pedestrian_count >= 0
  )

# Identify sufficiently complete days
valid_days <- recent_data |>
  group_by(location_id, year, sensing_date) |>
  summarise(
    hours_observed = n_distinct(hourday),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(hours_observed >= 23)

# Check coverage in each year
recent_coverage <- valid_days |>
  group_by(location_id, year) |>
  summarise(
    days_observed = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expected_days = if_else(leap_year(year), 366, 365),
    coverage = days_observed / expected_days
  )

# Retain sensors with good coverage in all 3 years
reliable_sensors <- recent_coverage |>
  group_by(location_id) |>
  summarise(
    years_covered = n_distinct(year),
    minimum_coverage = min(coverage),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(
    years_covered == 3,
    minimum_coverage >= 0.80
  )

reliable_sensors |>
  summarise(sensors_selected = n())
# A tibble: 1 × 1
  sensors_selected
             <int>
1               44
hourly_profiles <- recent_data |>
  semi_join(
    valid_days,
    by = c("location_id", "year", "sensing_date")
  ) |>
  semi_join(
    reliable_sensors,
    by = "location_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    day_type = if_else(
      lubridate::wday(sensing_date, week_start = 1) <= 5,
      "Weekday",
      "Weekend"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(location_id, day_type, hourday) |>
  summarise(
    typical_count = median(pedestrian_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(location_id) |>
  filter(
    n() == 48,
    sum(typical_count) > 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hour_share = typical_count / sum(typical_count)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
# One row per sensor, with 48 profile measurements
cluster_features <- hourly_profiles |>
  mutate(
    feature = paste0(
      day_type,
      "_",
      str_pad(hourday, width = 2, pad = "0")
    )
  ) |>
  select(location_id, feature, hour_share) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = feature,
    values_from = hour_share
  ) |>
  drop_na()

# Calculate distances between sensor profiles
sensor_distances <- cluster_features |>
  select(-location_id) |>
  stats::dist()

set.seed(123)

# Test 2 to 5 clusters
cluster_tests <- tibble(k = 2:5) |>
  mutate(
    model = map(
      k,
      ~ stats::kmeans(
        cluster_features |> select(-location_id),
        centers = .x,
        nstart = 30
      )
    ),
    silhouette = map_dbl(
      model,
      ~ mean(
        cluster::silhouette(
          .x$cluster,
          sensor_distances
        )[, "sil_width"]
      )
    )
  )

cluster_tests |>
  select(k, silhouette)
# A tibble: 4 × 2
      k silhouette
  <int>      <dbl>
1     2      0.442
2     3      0.252
3     4      0.264
4     5      0.270
best_k <- cluster_tests |>
  slice_max(
    silhouette,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  pull(k)

set.seed(123)

final_kmeans <- stats::kmeans(
  cluster_features |> select(-location_id),
  centers = best_k,
  nstart = 50
)

sensor_clusters <- cluster_features |>
  select(location_id) |>
  mutate(
    cluster = paste0(
      "Cluster ",
      final_kmeans$cluster
    )
  )

  arrange(desc(dip_rate_pct))

# Interactive map
sensor_dip_map <- leaflet::leaflet(
  data = sensor_dip_map_ready
) %>%
  leaflet::addTiles() %>%
  leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 5,
    color = ~sensor_palette(dip_rate_pct),
    fillColor = ~sensor_palette(dip_rate_pct),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    weight = 1,
    label = ~paste0(
      sensor_name,
      " | Dip rate: ", dip_rate_pct, "%"
    ),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Sensor: </b>", sensor_name,
      "<br><b>Location ID: </b>", location_id,
      "<br><b>Reporting days: </b>", days_reporting,
      "<br><b>Dip days: </b>", dip_days,
      "<br><b>Dip rate: </b>", dip_rate_pct, "%",
      "<br><b>Median dip: </b>", median_dip_pct, "%"
    )
  ) %>%
  leaflet::addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = sensor_palette,
    values = ~dip_rate_pct,
    title = "Dip rate (%)",
    opacity = 0.8
  )

sensor_dip_map
